title: Strict simplicial groupoids
statement: A strict simplicial groupoid is a small simplicial category with a constant object set, together with simplicial maps between each pair of opposite mapping spaces. In every simplicial degree, these maps are strict two-sided inverses for enriched composition and the simplicial identity arrows. Use the locally Kan and coherent-nerve conventions of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. It is fibrant when every mapping simplicial set is a Kan complex.

source.place: Gepner--Haugseng, Remark 4.2.5: simplicial groupoids are simplicial objects in ordinary groupoids with constant objects; fibrancy means Kan mapping spaces. The remark cites Dwyer--Kan, Homotopy theory and simplicial groupoids, Theorems 2.5 and 3.3.
